scoring_justification: Only the final barrier value is output; no intermediate energy files are required to be saved, so recomputing the barrier from raw energies is not possible. Result‑level compare with tolerance is acceptable per D4 T0.

hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper‑reported value in J. Am. Chem. Soc. 1990, 112, 7167; cited as 2.4 kcal/mol.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: Value is the paper's own published result; verified against the source.

outputs.description: Computed pseudorotation barrier for SiH5- at MP2/6-31G(d,p) level, written as a single float in kcal/mol.

output_contract.notes: The checker reads the barrier value from /app/outputs/barrier_kcal_mol.txt and compares it against a target value using an exact_match policy with a tolerance (not disclosed). The barrier must be computed by the workflow described in the process steps; a hard-coded value may be detected only by the tolerance window.

steps.description: Compare extracted float to paper gold 2.4 kcal/mol with absolute tolerance 1.0
